surprises.head: San Jose won without the better chances
surprises.body: Expected goals favoured Florida, 4.0 to 3.5, with empty nets left out. Y. Askarov stopped 1.0 more goals than expected.

surprises.head: Florida tried a different line
surprises.body: B. Tkachuk, L. Eller, S. Reinhart played 5:58 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Florida’s usual lines.
